title: Computer Vision and Geometry Group | Computer Vision - 2022
description: * Thu. 13:15-14:00 in CAB G 51. * Thu. 13:15-14:00 in 263-5902-00L Computer Vision. Computer Vision (following Tomaso Poggio, MIT): Computer Vision, formerly an almost esoteric corner of research and regarded as a field of research still in its infancy, has emerged to a key discipline in computer science. Computer Vision is still far from being a solved problem, and most exciting developments, discoveries, and applications still lie ahead of us. All the materials for lectures and exercises will be posted on moodle. You will also have to submit the exercises there. You can also ask private questions to TAs through the moodle system. The objectives of this course are: - To introduce the fundamental problems of computer vision. - To enable participants to make sense of the computer vision literature. The target audience of this course are Master's Degree students who are interested in getting a basic understanding of computer vision. * Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications.

title: Computer Vision and Geometry Group
description: ### Computer Vision. The goal of this course is to provide students with a good understanding of computer vision and image analysis techniques. The goal of this course is an introduction and hands-on experience on latest mixed reality technology at the cross-section of 3D computer graphics and vision, human machine interaction, as well as gaming technology. This course acquaints students with core knowledge in computer graphics, image processing, multimedia and computer vision. ### Seminar: Deep Learning for Computer Vision. ### Doctoral Seminar in Visual Computing. In this doctoral seminar, current research at the Institute for Visual Computing will be presented and discussed. ### Seminar in Advanced Topics in Vision. This seminar covers advanced topics in computer vision, such as 3D reconstruction, image understanding, object detection, people tracking, motion prediction, and other related topics. This seminar provides an overview of techniques in the field of embodied intelligence.
